services.name: Dolphin & Nature
services.desc: This is the perfect trip to get the family or a group of friends out on the water and explore the intercoastal waterways. Your cruise begins with pickup from the most convenient location in Sarasota or Longboat Key. Captain Jim will take you into the crystal blue waters of the Gulf of Mexico where you can relax, enjoy your favorite music, and take in the beautiful scenery. As you cruise around the Sarasota Bay Estuary, you may have the opportunity to see dolphins, manatees, pelicans, fish, and a variety of coastal birds. services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing private brunch cruise through the beautiful waterways of Sarasota, Siesta Key, Anna Maria Island, and Longboat Key. Gather your friends or family and experience a laid-back morning on the water with scenic views and great company. Cruise the intercoastal waterways while enjoying your favorite breakfast foods, coffee, mimosas, or cocktails. Relax to your favorite music and take in the waterfront homes, wildlife, and Gulf Coast scenery. This is a perfect option for birthdays, girls trips, family outings, or simply enjoying a beautiful Florida morning on the water. A $100 plus tax deposit is collected at the time of booking. Your card will be charged for the balance on the day

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Fish Sarasota Bay and the surrounding waterways with a lifelong Floridian outdoorsman. Captain Jim Simmons specializes in Sarasota, Tampa Bay, and near shore fishing with light tackle. Your captain is U.S. Coast Guard licensed and fully insured. On your fishing charter, you may target snook, snapper, redfish, trout, mackerel, grouper, and other local fish species. Fishing charters take place on a spacious 26 ft Andros boat and can accommodate up to 6 people per trip. Captain Jim provides rods, reels, and live or artificial bait prepared in advance, giving you more time on the water for an enjoyable fishing experience.
